title: Deborah, the Wise and Brave
reflectionQuestion: Deborah was wise and brave, and God went ahead of his people to keep them safe. I wonder what brave thing God might help you do, knowing he goes ahead of you?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Judges -- 3rd story in the category). Toward-100 + REGISTER VARIETY: a brave WOMAN (most kid courage stories are male -- David, Gideon, Samson); fills the four-registers/anti-all-comfort need. WATCH-ITEM: soft on battle -- NO fighting/gore; God sends a storm, the enemy chariots get stuck in mud, the enemy 'ran far away'. Sisera's tent-peg death is OMITTED entirely. The HEART = God gives wisdom + courage to all kinds of people (girls and women too), and 'God goes ahead of you' so you are never alone. Deborah the wise judge under her palm tree; Barak braver with her along. Ends with Deborah's song of thanks. Soft close ('way'). VOICE_DEBORAH_WISE (on-the-nose: voices Deborah herself; wise/warm female).
